instructions: Tools for a headless Blender 5 server with GPU rendering. Build and edit scenes with execute_code (bpy), check your work with preview (it returns an image), render with render, and keep projects in scenes/ with save_file / open_file / list_projects. The person watches the scene in the Blender panel beside the chat, which refreshes after every scene change; its timeline plays the scene's frame range, so set frame_start / frame_end / fps when you animate. One Blender is shared by every chat and the person: check list_projects before replacing the open scene. Paths are relative to the server's data folder; projects live in scenes/<name>.blend.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Blender version, GPU devices and the open file.

tools.name: get_scene_info
tools.description: Current scene: engine, resolution, frame range and up to 200 objects with transforms.

tools.name: get_object_info
tools.description: Transform, dimensions, materials and mesh stats of one object.

tools.name: execute_code
tools.description: Run Python in Blender with `bpy` available; returns whatever it prints. Use this to build or change anything in the scene. The live browser view refreshes afterwards, also after an error; in a script that takes long, call refresh_view() between its steps so the person sees the scene take shape while it runs.

read_only.description: Set true when the code only inspects the scene: skips the unsaved-changes mark and the browser view refresh

tools.name: preview
tools.description: Quick Workbench render from the scene camera (or an automatic view if there is none), returned as an image. Use it to check your work after edits.

tools.name: render
tools.description: Full render from the scene camera, saved under renders/ unless `path` is given. The person sees it in the chat, and it is saved in the chat's folder too (blender-renders/); you get the image unless return_image is false.

path.description: Output .png path. Paths are relative to the server's data folder; projects live in scenes/<name>.blend.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export the scene to a file under the data folder.

path.description: Output path, e.g. exports/scene.glb. Paths are relative to the server's data folder; projects live in scenes/<name>.blend.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Projects (.blend files) in scenes/, newest first, plus the open project and whether it has unsaved changes.

tools.name: open_file
tools.description: Open a .blend, replacing the current scene (unsaved changes are lost; check list_projects first).

path.description: e.g. scenes/island.blend. Paths are relative to the server's data folder; projects live in scenes/<name>.blend.

tools.name: save_file
tools.description: Save the scene to a .blend (also makes it the open project and writes its thumbnail).

path.description: e.g. scenes/my_project.blend. Paths are relative to the server's data folder; projects live in scenes/<name>.blend.

tools.name: new_scene
tools.description: Start a new scene, replacing the current one (unsaved changes are lost). With `name` it is saved straight away as scenes/<name>.blend.
